what.text: People were internally displaced within Nigeria, while others sought refuge or asylum abroad.
In 2025, UNHCR reported 3544519 internally displaced persons inside the country.
In 2025, IDMC estimated 3495705 people living in internal displacement.
The refugee population from Nigeria reached 478150 in 2025.

why.text: Conflict episodes involved the Government of Nigeria against Ahlul Sunnah Jamaa in 2004 and against NDPVF in 2004.
Conflict was also recorded between the Government of Nigeria and JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025.
Other conflict episodes included the Government of Nigeria against IS from 2015 to 2025, and against IPOB from 2021 to 2025.
Disaster events were also recorded alongside conflict movements in various years.

when.text: New displacement movements from conflict occurred across many years, including 975300 in 2014 and 353624 in 2025.
Disaster displacement movements were recorded in multiple years, including 3894063 in 2012 and 2437411 in 2022.
Refugee figures ranged from 51100 in 1968 to 478150 in 2025.
Asylum seekers were reported at 87289 in 2024 and 56176 in 2025.

how.text: UNHCR reports on internally displaced people protected or assisted inside Nigeria.
IDMC measures end-of-year internal displacement from conflict as well as disaster displacement movements.
Disaster counts measure movements rather than individual people.
The sources don't say where people live or how they moved.
